title: Departures
description: Upcoming tour departures with their travellers, capacity and assigned guide.

agenda.summary: {total, plural, =0 {No departures} one {# departure, {withoutGuide, plural, =0 {it has a guide} other {it has no guide}}} other {# departures, {withoutGuide, plural, =0 {all have a guide} other {# without a guide}}}} ({from} to {to})
agenda.daysAgo: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}

noMatch.title: No matching departures
noMatch.description: Try another date range or tour, or turn off the without-guide filter.

empty.title: No departures yet
empty.description: Departures show up here as soon as a booking is pending or confirmed in the next 30 days.

capacity.label: {confirmed} confirmed and {pending} pending travellers out of {capacity} seats
capacity.title: Capacity

closed.title: {date} is closed for booking
closed.body: The bookings on this departure are still active. Make sure the tour still runs, or contact the guests to rearrange their date.

manifest.title: Manifest
manifest.empty: There are no active bookings on this departure.
manifest.totals: Total ({count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}})
manifest.showCancelled: Show {count, plural, one {# cancelled booking} other {# cancelled bookings}}
manifest.internalNotes: {count, plural, one {# internal note} other {# internal notes}}

guide.title: Guide
guide.suggestedHint: Guides who usually work at this destination are listed first.
guide.noGuides: There are no active guides yet. Add a guide first.
guide.busyHint: {name} is already guiding {tours} on the same days. Make sure the schedules don't clash.
guide.inactive: This guide is no longer active. Assign another guide.

send.description: Email the manifest (no prices or payment details) to the guide, in Indonesian.
send.needsEmail: This guide has no email address. Use WhatsApp or complete the guide's record.
send.empty: There are no active bookings to send.

whatsapp.noPhone: The guide's WhatsApp number is missing or invalid.
whatsapp.message: Hello {guide}, here is the summary for {tour} on {date}. Meeting point: {place}. {participants} travellers from {bookings} bookings. The full manifest was sent by email. Thank you!

note.title: Operational note
note.description: Shared with the guide along with the manifest, e.g. meeting time or vehicle.
note.label: Note for the guide
note.placeholder: e.g. meet at 04:30, white Hiace B 1234 XY.

history.title: History
history.empty: No changes on this departure yet.
history.sentTo: To {email}, {participants, plural, one {# traveller} other {# travellers}}
history.sentToGuide: To {name} ({email}), {participants, plural, one {# traveller} other {# travellers}}

dashboard.label: Departures in the next 7 days without a guide
dashboard.count: {count, plural, =0 {No departures without a guide} one {# departure without a guide} other {# departures without a guide}}
